purpose: Teach: 出費/税関/駆けつけ/散々/利息/定時/月間/多忙

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 出費の管理、若い頃は苦労した。
lines.en: Managing money — I struggled with it when I was young.
lines.style: Unhurried, reflective opening. Quiet authority from lived experience. Slight pause between clauses, like he's revisiting an old memory. Warm but unsentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。税関手続きも、当時は紙ベースで散々でしたね。
lines.en: Yes. Customs procedures too — everything was paper-based back then. It was a mess.
lines.style: Steady agreement, meeting his gaze. Respectful but not deferential. Recognition in the voice that they share an era. Professional, measured delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 駆けつける部下、信頼関係で動いていた。
lines.en: The staff would come running when needed. Everything moved on trust.
lines.style: Nostalgic observation, not quite wistful. Small nod in the voice. Deliberate pace — each phrase lands. Underlying respect for that simpler structure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 利息と月間予算、管理を厳しくしています。
lines.en: I keep interest and the monthly budget under tight control now.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact. Slight edge of pride without boasting. Demonstrates competence through simple statement. Direct eye contact in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 多忙でも、定時で帰せ。それが長期の利益だ。
lines.en: Even when it's busy, send them home on time. That's long-term profit.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. The wisdom of hard-won understanding. Slight pause before the final sentence — the capstone. Delivered like settled fact, not suggestion.
